post_update_notes: Nothing manual required. Includes a security fix for a path-traversal issue in cross-server backup restore, and a fix for the legacy backup:database command exposing your DB password to other local users via `ps aux` on shared hosting — if you've run that specific command on a shared host, consider rotating that password. Paysera is available as a second payment gateway alongside Airwallex; add credentials under Settings → Payment Settings to enable it, otherwise checkout behavior is unchanged. Airwallex's new "Hold Funds Until Shipment" is opt-in and off by default — existing auto-capture-at-checkout behavior does not change unless you enable it. Invoice PDFs generated before this update remain wherever they were saved; only newly-generated invoices use the corrected, collision-free file path.
